info.name: Al-Giwar API v1
info.description:
Import into Postman. Set baseUrl if needed.

1) Run Auth → Login first (saves {{token}}).
2) Admin Create/Update/Delete and booking List/Update/Delete use Bearer {{token}}.
3) Public GETs and public form POSTs need no token.

Seeded logins:
- admin@gmail.com / admin123@
- manager@gmail.com / manager123@
- viewer@gmail.com / viewer123@

Bodies use snake_case to match Laravel validation.

body.raw:
{
  "first_name": "Ahmed",
  "last_name": "Test",
  "email": "ahmed@example.com",
  "phone": "+201000000000",
  "country": "egypt",
  "subject": "Trip inquiry",
  "service": "tours",
  "message": "I would like a 7-day Egypt itinerary.",
  "privacy": true
}
